title: Bound European dynamic byte-copy producers and literal ownership
changes: Classified the 40 European dynamic direct byte-copy calls into eight producer families. Bounded the 264-byte record loop at 08c00a to EWRAM source slots 2 through 23.
Compared 124 producer literal words at 125 original readers with the exact e343 generation. Recorded 84 unowned words (336 bytes) at 85 readers as a single extraction unit.
validation: Wine rd18kcew, e4k9r2zs and w7i6m4kp attest 14,233 distinct Thumb halfwords. All 18, 22 and 26 input guards pass and Wine drains after each unit.
The e343 ownership join d7fx1ud0 passes 21 input guards and retains the exact per-call plan and residual span hashes.
limitations: The runtime bank, 39 live source domains, other stack and indirect producers, ordinary and generated dispatch, original BIOS, Linux and USA remain open. No performance measurements.
